Open • FLYBYME (Tim) opened about 1 minute ago • 0 comments
Labels: package


  Roadmap A7.7, and it stops being a later audit the moment forms arrive.     
                                                                              
  An Application never writes an element — it writes  Stack ,  Text ,  Button 
  ,                                                                           
   Input . view-layer §3 /mesh-web/spec/view-layer.md: "If nobody writes      
   div , nobody writes  HTMLElement  either."                                 
                                                                              
  That is the whole opportunity and the whole risk. The library owns every    
  role,                                                                       
  label and focus order, and an Application cannot patch around a mistake it  
  makes. Nineteen primitives get it right once, or six hundred call sites get 
  it                                                                          
  wrong separately and no amount of review finds them.                        
                                                                              
  ## Why now                                                                  
                                                                              
  A schema-driven form vocabulary is being built in mesh-core against these   
  primitives. Forms are where accessibility is least optional — a field with  
  no                                                                          
  programmatic label is not a style problem, it is a field that cannot be     
  filled                                                                      
  in — and a generated form multiplies whatever the primitives do, correctly  
  or                                                                          
  otherwise, across every collection on the platform.                         
                                                                              
  Get it right underneath and the generated forms inherit it. Get it wrong and
  the                                                                         
  generator faithfully reproduces the same defect ~154 times.                 
                                                                              
  ## What to do                                                               
                                                                              
  Audit  PRIMITIVES  in  src/render/component.ts  and give each one the roles,
  labelling and focus behaviour it owes.  Dialog ,  Input ,  TextArea ,       
  Button ,                                                                    
   List / ListItem  and  DropZone  are where the real decisions are.          
                                                                              
  Two that are already known to matter here:                                  
                                                                              
  •  spaceIsTextInput  exists because Space must activate a  Button  and type 
  a space in an  Input . That is the shape of this whole task: the primitive  
  knows what it is, the call site does not.                                   
  • A label is a relationship, not a string. Whatever  ui.form  ends up       
  emitting,  Input  needs a way to be labelled by another node rather than    
  carrying a  label  prop that renders text nearby and associates nothing.    
                                                                              
  Say plainly which primitives you changed, which you decided were already    
  correct,                                                                    
  and which need an API change that is not yours to make unilaterally — a     
  primitive                                                                   
  that cannot be made accessible without a new prop is a finding worth        
  reporting                                                                   
  before it is worth fixing.                                                  
                                                                              
  This is a kernel change, so it is a PATCH. At 0.x a minor invalidates every 
  part.

  A schema-driven form vocabulary is being built in mesh-core against these   
  primitives. Forms are where accessibility is least optional — a field with  
  no

  filled
